scheme_name: West Bengal Student Credit Card Scheme
other_conditions: Resident of West Bengal for at least 10 years (self‑declaration)
Enrolled in higher education programmes or coaching institutes for competitive examinations
Both student and parent/legal guardian must co‑submit the loan application
benefits_summary: Provides a loan up to ₹10,00,000 at a 4% simple annual interest rate with no collateral security required.
